item.title: Refactor order status strings to OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Refactor the orders crate as requested.

Requirements:
- Add src/status.rs with pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }, deriving Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash.
- Implement OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str yielding lowercase names pending, paid, shipped, cancelled; Display yields the same.
- Implement FromStr for OrderStatus with type Err = ParseStatusError. ParseStatusError is public, implements std::error::Error, and its message names the rejected input.
- Implement OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool: allow pending -> paid/cancelled and paid -> shipped/cancelled, and no other transitions.
- Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError at crate root, and use the enum throughout so status string literals occur only in src/status.rs.
- Preserve observable behavior, including errors, report output and ordering, and parsing.

Run cargo test and ensure it passes. Commit the completed change on the local branch; do not push.
Acceptance: implementation meets every bullet, existing behavior is preserved, cargo test passes, and the work is committed.
